name: serum-mcp
description: Generate, edit and save Xfer Serum 2 (.SerumPreset) synth presets from a plain-English description.
long_description: serum-mcp writes and edits real Xfer Serum 2 preset files directly on disk from a plain-English description -- no DAW, no audio rendering, and no Serum plugin instance involved at any point. Ask for a sound the same way you'd ask for a code change, then open the result in Serum inside whatever DAW you use. Open source (MIT); see the README for parameter-schema confidence notes and current scope.

presets_path.title: Serum presets folder
presets_path.description: Your Serum 2 "Presets/User" folder (see Serum's own "Show Serum Presets folder" menu item). Leave empty to use the standard install location for your OS if it exists.

sample_bank_path.title: Default sample bank folder (optional)
sample_bank_path.description: A folder of your own one-shots/drumkits to use as the default source for list_sample_files when you don't specify one explicitly.
